name: one-on-one-prep
description: Prepares a manager's next 1:1 with one report from the last meeting's notes and the recent updates the manager pastes into the chat: talking points, open-ended questions and concrete things to recognize. Commitments from the last notes are checked against the updates (done / in progress / no evidence), the manager's own unfulfilled commitments are flagged, and every item quotes the notes or updates verbatim. Personal or HR matters are found in code and left out unless the manager says to include them. Follow-ups: only the questions, recognize only, add a topic, drop an item, show sources, as json, or ask what was agreed last time. It never evaluates or compares people, never infers feelings and sends nothing. Not for performance reviews or general management advice.

skills.name: Prepare a 1:1
skills.description: Talking points, questions and recognition for the next 1:1, from pasted notes and updates: carry-overs checked against the updates, the manager's own open commitments flagged, every item quoted.
examples: Prep my 1:1 with Priya. Notes: <last meeting's notes> Updates: <what happened since>
What did we agree about on-call?
